import Mathlib.Topology.EMetricSpace.Diam
open scoped ENNReal
variable {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [PseudoEMetricSpace M]

example {C : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x y : M, edist x y ≤ C) :
    Metric.ediam (Set.univ : Set M) ≤ C := by
  refine Metric.ediam_le ?_
  intro x _ y _
  exact h x y

example {R : ℝ} (p y : M)
    (hdiam : Metric.ediam (Set.univ : Set M) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
    edist p y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R :=
  le_trans (Metric.edist_le_ediam_of_mem (Set.mem_univ p) (Set.mem_univ y)) hdiam
generic_probe_after:
import Mathlib.Topology.EMetricSpace.Diam
open scoped ENNReal
variable {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [PseudoEMetricSpace M]

example {C : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x y : M, edist x y ≤ C) :
    Metric.ediam (Set.univ : Set M) ≤ C := by
  simp only [Metric.ediam, iSup_le_iff]
  intro x _ y _
  exact h x y

example {R : ℝ} (p y : M)
    (hdiam : Metric.ediam (Set.univ : Set M) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
    edist p y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R := by
  have hedist : edist p y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R := by
    calc
      edist p y ≤ Metric.ediam (Set.univ : Set M) :=
        le_iSup_of_le p (le_iSup_of_le (Set.mem_univ p)
          (le_iSup_of_le y (le_iSup_of_le (Set.mem_univ y) le_rfl)))
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R := hdiam
  exact hedist
